'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Brian Fried LS Dantooine Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Fried]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Inventory Fred; team Brian Fried. Sheet D.B. / Ewok-fish. Y-wing Dantooine.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Brian Fried]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Dantooine Base Operations / More Dangerous Than You Realize|Dantooine Base Operations]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
